historical_references.reference: The name Debojit is a compound of two Sanskrit words - 'Deba' which means God and 'Jit' which means victory. It is believed that this name was given to warriors who had defeated their enemies and dedicated their victory to their deities. The name likely became popular during ancient Hindu warfare periods, such as the Mahabharata or the Gupta Empire.

The name Debojit highlights his divine connection as a manifestation of the god who has secured victory over all obstacles.
